# K West Mortgage (kwestmortgages.com)

> Buying in Key West? Don't assume it has to be jumbo. A Key West and Monroe County mortgage concierge that compares high-balance conforming, jumbo, VA, FHA, DSCR, bank-statement, and self-employed options before you write the offer. A Florida service of West Coast Capital Mortgage.

K West Mortgage is a Key West and Monroe County mortgage service, operated by West Coast Capital Mortgage with broker Anatoliy Kanevsky. It is scenario-first: start with your situation, compare the review paths, and avoid defaulting to jumbo when a high-balance conforming or alternative-documentation loan fits better. The team speaks English, Russian, and Ukrainian; some pages are also available as translations.

- Market: Florida (Key West, Monroe County)
- NMLS #2817729 · FL OFR License #MBR8669 · CA DRE #02440065 · Broker Anatoliy Kanevsky NMLS #2775380 · CA DRE #01385024
- Contact: (561) 956-8866 · Office (310) 654-1577 · info@kwestmortgages.com
- Office address: 150 E Olive Ave, Unit 112, Burbank, CA 91502. Serving Key West & Monroe County.
- Equal Housing Opportunity. Rates and program availability change; nothing here is a commitment to lend.

## Programs
- [DSCR loans](https://kwestmortgages.com/dscr-loans): Investor loans qualified on rental income.
- [Bank-statement loans](https://kwestmortgages.com/bank-statement-loans): Income from deposits for self-employed borrowers.
- [Self-employed mortgage](https://kwestmortgages.com/self-employed-mortgage): Qualifying options for business owners.
- [Foreign-national loans](https://kwestmortgages.com/foreign-national-loans): Financing for non-US-resident buyers.
- [Second-home financing](https://kwestmortgages.com/second-home-financing): Loans for second and vacation homes.
